title: A HISTORIC PERFORMANCE: the national table tennis team reaches the final stage of the European Team Championships for the first time
body_html:
The table tennis team made up of ATTP members and International Masters of Sport Vladislav URSU, Andrei PUȚUNTICA and Felix COZMOLICI continues to make history for Moldova with a remarkable result in the qualifying stage of the European Team Table Tennis Championships. For the first time ever, our team has reached the final stage of this prestigious tournament, to the delight and pride of fans across the country.

A sure path to success

The qualifying stage was a real challenge for the Moldovan team, which faced strong rivals from across Europe. Yet thanks to their professionalism, perseverance and team spirit, our players exceeded expectations and delivered impressive performances.

Vladislav URSU stood out in particular: his will to win inspired every member of the team to fight to the last point.

Why this historic achievement matters

Reaching the final stage of the European Team Table Tennis Championships is a significant step forward for table tennis in the Republic of Moldova. This success not only raises the country’s standing in international sport once again but also inspires more and more young people to take up the sport. Growing interest in table tennis has already been noticed across the country over the past three years, thanks to the joint efforts of ATTP and the sport’s associations.

What’s next?

The final stage promises to be a tough test, as our team will face the strongest teams in Europe, whose players are at the top of the world table tennis rankings. But we know our players are determined. They are ready not only to show a high level of play but to keep writing a new chapter in the history of Moldovan sport with glorious wins.

Come on, Moldova!
